mr_title: Allow 'status' and 'error' to be excluded from error response
mr_description:
Update `ErrorAttributeOptions` to allow the `status` and `error`
fields to be excluded from the response without throwing a
NullPointerException.

expected_issues.title: ErrorAttributes invoked twice per error
expected_issues.description:
renderErrorView/renderErrorResponse now call getErrorAttributes() twice per error, which invokes user-provided ErrorAttributes twice (duplicated side effects/cost) and can yield a status inconsistent with the rendered attributes.

ErrorAttributes is a user extension point; custom implementations may log, record metrics, or compute a status from the exception. Calling it once with ONLY_STATUS and once with the full options doubles those side effects and, if the implementation customises 'status', the HTTP status and the body can disagree. Compute the attributes once and only fall back to a default status lookup when 'status' is excluded.
